'''Tempest''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. The Witch was able to manipulate the elements in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to generate various degrees of a storm, ranging from a light wind up to a raging hurricane.<ref name="CTD" />
